fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int => if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

write_line("gcd(48, 18) = {gcd(48, 18)}")
write_line("gcd(1071, 462) = {gcd(1071, 462)}")
write_line("gcd(0, 13) = {gcd(0, 13)}")
write_line("gcd(13, 0) = {gcd(13, 0)}")
